title: Beetroot and Hash Irish-Style Hash Browns
description: A twist on traditional hash browns, this French-inspired dish adds the earthy sweetness of beetroot and the comfort of Irish ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated beetroot, Irish hash, chopped onion, minced garlic, and grated potato.
In a separate bowl, whisk together beaten eggs, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the egg mixture over the beetroot mixture and stir until well combined.
Heat the lacto margarine or butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the beetroot mixture to the skillet and press down with a spatula to form a flat layer.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the bottom is golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving.
